title: On load: the top bar reads Rome, its gold, food, and manpower with their daily change, Year 1, day 1, and speed 1
After 2.5 seconds at speed 1: the day counter has advanced
Space pressed: the top bar reads Paused and the button offers Resume
Two seconds later: the day has not moved while paused
Resumed and switched to speed 3: the speed 3 button is pressed
After 2.5 seconds at speed 3: the day has jumped about twelve days
Time controls: the day counter runs, pauses on Space, and runs faster at speed 3
